description: Quality-ranked PocketPolyglot queue for user-supplied Sengoku history, primary-source translation, reference works, and historical novels.

generation_contract.source_fidelity: Preserve the declared source spine exactly. Translate every source unit completely and in order; never summarize, silently omit, modernize facts, or invent connective material.
generation_contract.japanese: Use natural, readable contemporary Japanese with ordinary inflection and kana. Add furigana only to kanji-bearing tokens during token promotion; reject Chinese prose presented as Japanese.
generation_contract.chinese: Use accurate, idiomatic modern Chinese. Preserve dates, names, ranks, quotations, uncertainty, citations, and distinctions between evidence and author interpretation.
generation_contract.english: When English is generated from a Chinese spine, use complete natural modern English and preserve literary voice without adding historical claims.
generation_contract.historical_method: Keep primary source, modern scholarship, popular synthesis, disputed thesis, and historical fiction explicitly distinct. Translation must not silently endorse, correct, or merge their claims.
generation_contract.grammar_analysis: Populate normalized grammar roles for English, Japanese, and Chinese so the same JSON supports color and black-white rendering while preserving English spaces.
generation_contract.figures: For image-rich sources, structured local extraction and source-ordered figure anchors are required before full generation. Never infer a caption that is not evidenced by the source.
generation_contract.final_outputs: Maximum-language large-font English/Japanese/Chinese color and black-white PDFs with cover and meaningful TOC. Chinese-spine fiction may additionally compile a Chinese-main edition.

deterministic: HTML, page-header, OCR-noise, and boilerplate rejection
quality_gate.sample_review: Review the first two accepted chunks for factual fidelity, natural modern Japanese, accurate modern Chinese, alignment, and unsupported additions.
quality_gate.promotion_rule: The gpt-5.4-mini low and medium pilots are rejected for this queue. Continue only after a gpt-5.6-sol low pilot passes; use gpt-5.5 low only as an availability fallback.

source_exact_replacements.evidence: The printed name, title, and hundreds of correctly recognized occurrences establish Hideyoshi; both OCR engines confused the same y glyph with v at seven body locations.
The same work prints Heian-kyō correctly elsewhere, including the notes; the embedded font map emitted final long-o as digit 6.
Visual inspection of printed page 49 confirms the complete word incompatibility; both OCR outputs omitted the second i.
Visual inspection of printed page 2 confirms a comma after imagination; both OCR engines misclassified it as a period.
Visual inspection of printed page 3 confirms the romanized Japanese term nō; the long-o diacritic was lost in both OCR outputs.
